section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analyses: the factor structure of the BAS-2 was examined via principal-axis exploratory factor analysis with quartimax rotation, using eigenvalues >1, scree plot inspection, and parallel analysis for factor retention. The EFA was conducted separately for women and men; ten independent t-tests compared BAS-2 items by gender and an additional t-test compared total BAS-2 scores, while Pearson correlations were used to examine associations among body appreciation, self-esteem, life satisfaction, BMI, and age.
